title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Handling Charge by the Length of the Withdrawal
content:
## Credit control schedule

A handling charge is carried into the clearance figure of a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record according to how long coverage has stood withdrawn. The reading is the days from the day coverage was suspended to the clearance day.

| Days coverage has stood suspended at the clearance day | Handling charge carried |
|---|---|
| more than 60 | the long withdrawal handling charge, 90.00 USD |
| more than 30 but no more than 60 | the withdrawal handling charge, 45.00 USD |
| no more than 30 | no handling charge |

### Boundary days

- At exactly 30 days suspended: "no more than 30", so no handling charge.
- At exactly 31 days: more than 30 and no more than 60, so 45.00 USD.
- At exactly 60 days: still no more than 60, so 45.00 USD.
- At exactly 61 days: more than 60, so 90.00 USD.

The handling charge is one figure carried once into the clearance figure, not a charge per day.
